headline: Nigerian Investors Lose N3.52 Trillion in Five-Day Market Slump
summary: Nigerian equities suffered a five-day slump driven by heavy sell-offs in market heavyweights including Dangote Cement Plc and Aradel Holdings Plc, wiping out N3.52 trillion.
why: Large-cap declines directly impact benchmark stock indexes and investor sentiment across the Nigerian exchange.

impacts.name: Nigerian Stock Exchange
impacts.why: Heavy sell-offs in major large-cap index heavyweights drive down overall market capitalization.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Heavy sell-offs in market heavyweights like Dangote Cement Plc and Aradel Holdings Plc caused a widespread decline in market capitalization over five days.
